suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 本章以梦境开场：叙述者躺在沼泽底部，周围是子宫般温暖的水，不需要呼吸。
facts.anchor: I lay at the bottom of a swamp, surrounded by womb-warm water, muck twisting and swirling around me.

facts.fact: 梦中一个黑眼睛女人用步枪瞄准她的左眼开枪，随后又向水里连发子弹，打穿鱼、蛇和鳄鱼，不许她休息。
facts.anchor: A woman with coal-black eyes stood several feet away, rifle stock planted on her shoulder, barrel aimed at my left eye. She fired.

facts.fact: 这个女人有多张脸，同时是 Ida、是 Gazzie，也是叙述者自己。
facts.anchor: She was Ida. She was Gazzie.

facts.fact: 叙述者回顾时认定这是 Ironheart 第一次向她现身，此前 Ida 曾潜入她在 Greer House 的梦境劝她继承遗志。
facts.anchor: Ida had infiltrated my dreams in Greer House to convince me to continue her legacy, and now Ironheart was trying to sway me to its side

facts.fact: Ironheart 通过梦境传达的诉求是：毁灭 Greer 一家。
facts.anchor: Destroy the Greers.

facts.fact: 她醒来时是晴朗的黑夜，月亮呈乳白色，后脑因撞地而痛，头皮有一处肿包，头发是湿的。
facts.anchor: The moon shone a creamy white, stars burning around it. Against the hard, flat ground, the back of my head ached.

facts.fact: 她意识到自己躺在 breeding pond（种鳄池）里，最近的鳄鱼张着嘴盯着她。
facts.anchor: An alligator stared back at me, mouth open, and the situation clarified immediately: I was lying by the breeding pond.

facts.fact: 十英尺高的铁丝网顶上有刺线无法攀爬，大门上着挂锁——是 Gazzie 把她锁在了鳄鱼栏里。
facts.anchor: Gazzie had locked me inside.

facts.fact: 她后悔独自一人去与 Gazzie 对质，本该听 Aunt Virginia 和 Harrison 的话。
facts.anchor: I’d been a fool to confront Gazzie by myself. I should have listened to Aunt Virginia, to Harrison.

facts.fact: 她在地上发现了 Gazzie 掷向她却没捡走的钳子，这成了她打开铁丝网的唯一工具。
facts.anchor: Then a piece of metal several feet away to my left caught the moonlight—the pliers Gazzie had thrown at me. She hadn’t picked them up when she left.

facts.fact: 她一边对鳄鱼低声说话稳住它们，一边蹲着挪步靠近钳子，然后用钳子剪开铁丝网，剪出了一个甜瓜大小的洞。
facts.anchor: I found a wire on the fence to my right with my fingers, positioned the pliers, and snipped.

facts.fact: 剪最后三下时，一只鳄鱼咬住她的右脚踝把她往水里拖，痛感从脚一路窜到腿。
facts.anchor: An anvil slammed onto my right ankle, and something jerked me forward, yanking my legs out from underneath me.

facts.fact: 她情急之下用钳子砸向鳄鱼的眼睛，没中，砸在吻部上，鳄鱼吃痛松口退回了水里，钳子插在它头上。
facts.anchor: In one movement, I sat up and slammed the pliers down in the direction of the alligator’s eye. I missed, landing on its snout.

facts.fact: 随后一声像强风的震耳嘶叫响起，池里所有鳄鱼像接到行军令一样成群向她围拢，她想象 Ironheart 胃部重新缝合、张着嘴跟在后面。
facts.anchor: A deafening hiss, like a gale-force wind, whooshed toward me.

facts.fact: 她向鳄鱼群和 Ironheart 喊出「我跟她们不一样」「我会修好」「我发誓」，嘶声随即停止，鳄鱼们一一退回池中。
facts.anchor: “I’m not like them!” I screamed.

facts.fact: 她在加工设施的处理间用急救包包扎伤脚：三四道鳄鱼齿穿透靴子留下的裂伤、整脚肿胀发红，之后吞了四粒对乙酰氨基酚。
facts.anchor: Then I popped four acetaminophen capsules.

facts.fact: 她透过后窗看见鳄鱼正从她剪开的洞里一只只钻出去，认为这是 Gazzie 罪有应得；停车场里 Gazzie 的 SUV 已不见，她开走了 Aunt Virginia 的 Bug。
facts.anchor: The alligators were squeezing out of the hole I’d made, one after another. Good. That was the least Gazzie deserved.

facts.fact: 她意识到自己正处在飓风 Flora 的风眼里——一个宽四十英里的纯自然现象，但她认同若 Gazzie 在场会说这是 Ironheart 让风眼停留的缘故。
facts.anchor: Now I know I was in the eye of Hurricane Flora. An entirely natural phenomenon, forty miles wide

facts.fact: 她在车里痛哭并下结论：Gazzie 像当年丢下 Leon 一样把她丢进鳄鱼栏，Gazzie 不可救赎，Ida 则更加罪无可赦。
facts.anchor: Gazzie was irredeemable. Ida was beyond that; Ida was damned.

facts.fact: 章末落点：她虽无清晰计划，仍忍着伤痛开车驶向 Greer House，因为她曾向鳄鱼、Ironheart 和自然本身许诺要让一切回归正道。
facts.anchor: I didn’t have a clear plan as I threw the car in drive, pressing the gas pedal with my tender foot, but I knew exactly where I was headed.
